PluginData.Author: JenfX
PluginData.Tooltip: Wheels get the same friction on blocks as on voxels; fixes turns sticking on blocks.
PluginData.Description: Makes wheels behave on blocks the same way as on voxels. Vanilla gives wheels only 7% friction on armor and 100% on functional blocks such as conveyors; with this plugin the friction on any block equals the wheel friction. Also fixes skid-steer (tank turn) scripts sticking on static grids: wheel contacts are recreated when the wheel friction changes, so the new friction applies immediately. Each suspension gets a "Voxel-like friction on blocks" checkbox (on by default). Multiplayer: required on the host/server only.
